note.zh-TW: 0-2 以 Profit 代表；計算器統一期間並標示是否年化。英文別名 net income 是美式用語。
note.en: Represented by Profit in the 0-2 slides; the calculator aligns the periods and says whether figures are annualised. The alias net income is American usage.

definition.zh-TW: 稅前淨利再扣掉所得稅費用後，這段期間真正賺到、屬於股東的獲利，是五層利益的最後一層。它會流進資產負債表的未分配盈餘。
definition.en: Profit before tax less income tax expense: what the period really earned for the shareholders, the last of the five profit levels. It flows into unappropriated retained earnings on the statement of financial position.
